title: Tri-City Herald death notices for Sept. 3, 2025 - NewsBreak
text:
By Tri-City Herald staff ,
16 hours ago Tri-City Herald death notices for Sept. 3, 2025 Ronald D. Peterson Ronald Dale Peterson, 92, of Pasco, died Sept. 1 in Pasco.
He was born in Milnor, N.D., and lived in the Tri-Cities for 13 years.
He was a retired farmer and welder.
Mueller’s Greenlee Funeral Home, Pasco, is in charge of arrangements.
David M. Dallaire David Marc Dallaire, 70, of Kennewick, died Aug. 31 in Kennewick.
He was born in Richland and lived in the Tri-Cities for 70 years.
He worked at Home Depot in the irrigation department.
Mueller’s Tri-Cities Funeral Home, Kennewick, is in charge of arrangements.
Terry Lindblom Terry Lindblom, 77, died Aug. 29 in the Tri-Cities.
Einan’s at Sunset, Richland, is in charge of arrangements.
Clarine V. Watkins Clarine Virginia Watkins, 88, of Richland, died Aug. 29 in Richland.
She was born in Wallingford, Iowa, and lived in the area for 80 years.
She was a former bartender.
Einan’s at Sunset, Richland, is in charge of arrangements.
Joseph T. Stockdill Joseph Trintan Stockdill, 28, of Richland, died Aug. 26 in Richland.
He was born in Eureka, Calif., and lived in Kennewick for 25 years.
He was a tattoo artist.
CODA Alternative Cremation & Funeral, Kennewick, is in charge of arrangements.
Andrew L. Sorn Andrew L. Sorn, 59, of Richland, died Aug. 17 in Nuremberg, Germany.
He was born in Homestead, Fla., and lived in the Tri-Cities for 32 years.
He was a self employed in sales for Andpak packaging and the former co-owner of Columbia Basin Ice.
Mueller’s Chapel of the Falls is in charge of arrangements.
